description: Recovered fx2-cmix GCC build with FX2_STRUCT_SIDECAR=1. Adds a decoder-recomputable FSL/OGI sidecar in ContextManager and injects its bounded structural hash into selected existing mixer context IDs without changing the coded byte stream.

build.packaging: cmix and english.dic are xz-packed and unpacked by program.py; both count toward local driver program_size.

notes: This is the high-potential sidecar injection path: structural state splits fx2's existing tuned mixer contexts instead of replacing fx2 with a standalone model.
Mode 1 mutates mixer contexts only; indirect byte contexts remain baseline.
verdict: Reject. Broad structural sidecar mutation fragmented too many mixer contexts and lost archive bytes at the 64 KiB screen.
